Our products are endorsed by international Trichologist, Raphael Tome and sold exclusively in professional hair salons across South Africa and Europe.

Product Overview

🌸 Quick Grow Shampoos & Conditioners: Our vegan, sulfate-free shampoos and sodium-chloride free conditioners are designed to create a growing environment on your scalp, feeding your follicles with all the building blocks of keratin for faster growing healthy hair.

🌸 Advanced Treatments: Faster growing hair is no good if you have to cut off your split ends all the time, which is why we created a range of treatments to protect the hair from split ends and breakage.

🌸 Collagen and Vitamins: Our vegan supplements offer a complete daily dose of all the vitamins, minerals and amino's needed for faster growing hair, skin and nails.  They create a clean, efficient and healthy environment for your body to produce collagen and keratin at its fastest rate with results of up to 3 x faster growing hair and nails and visible more radiant skin within 2 weeks of consistent use.
